name: perture
description: Thin Codex connector for Perture brand context, frontend contracts, and validation.

interface.longDescription: Perture connects Codex to remote brand context, versioned frontend contracts, deterministic check orchestration, project memory, Works submission, Canva asset preparation, and validation tools served by app.perture.co. The plugin contains no proprietary rules or local implementation logic.
defaultPrompt: Prepare and verify frontend changes with Perture.
